# Implement Phase

Read the required files in `AGENTS.md` before editing. Confirm the user has specified an authorized phase and bounded scope; otherwise produce a preflight and ask for direction without implementing.

Implement only approved work. Preserve existing content and production invariants. Do not invent tenant configuration, access, resources, data, test results, or approvals. Do not connect to production, create credentials, commit, or push unless separately authorized.

Before edits, report the planned files, scope, and risks. After edits, run focused validation, review the diff, update relevant documentation and current status, and report exact results and remaining decisions. Use synthetic data only.
